title: Campus Feeding
description: Every morning, before the first lecture bell, our volunteers walk the campus with warm meals for our four-legged residents.

title: Emergency Rescue
description: A 24/7 rescue line for injured strays across Coimbatore — trained volunteers, first-aid kits, and a network of partner clinics.

title: Pet Adoption
description: Rehabilitated dogs, cats and birds waiting for a forever home. Every adoption is a promise kept for life.

title: Vaccination Camps
description: Free anti-rabies and preventive care camps in partnership with local veterinarians — because prevention is protection.

title: Awareness Programs
description: Workshops, campus talks and street theatre — because coexistence begins with understanding.

title: Tree Plantation
description: Every rescue needs a home. Every home needs a canopy. We plant, we water, we nurture.
